177:t_1:3.en: ～ Inside the Imperial Capital $$ラース・バビロン$$ ～

177:t_1:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「...What a dreary bunch. Would it kill you to put on a friendly smile once in a while?」

177:t_1:8.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「You show us how it's done.」

177:t_1:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Me? Smile for you lot? That's a joke that isn't funny.」

177:t_1:10.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「The fact that you made a joke is funny, though.」

177:t_1:12.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I'm not used to soothing children.」

177:t_1:14.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I know it's in your nature. But it's an eyesore.」

177:t_1:15.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Can you even see me with those eyes, $$尸空#pilot$$?」

177:t_1:16.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Sight has nothing to do with it. Let me put it another way: your very existence is in the way.」

177:t_1:19.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「I know, $$ストラウス$$. I have no intention of causing trouble.」

177:t_1:22.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「It should be time for His Majesty to arrive.」

177:t_1:23.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Being His Majesty the Emperor must be rough. I feel for him.」

177:t_1:25.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Do you want to make me angry that badly?」

177:t_1:27.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Even if it's nothing new, it's unsightly.」

177:t_1:28.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「About time you showed up.」

177:t_1:29.en:
$$尸空#pilot$$
「Then shall we begin the report meeting, $$アウストラリス$$?」

177:t_1:34.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Briefing Room ～

177:t_1:36.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Our squads have joined up, and I hear they're swapping info in the $$クォーター$$'s hangar. Want to stop by?」

177:t_1:37.en:
$n
「Go to the hangar, hear the other units out」
「Don't go to the hangar」

177:t_1:39.en:
$n
「I hear there are new members, too. I should meet them.」

177:t_1:42.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It beats the kind of smile people call scary, like yours, $n.」

177:t_1:44.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Just kidding. That smile was because I'm happy you've changed, $n.」

177:t_1:46.en:
$$スズネ$$
(What a reaction... He must have really cared about it.)

177:t_1:48.en:
$$スズネ$$
「W-well... Let's set that aside for now...」

177:t_1:51.en:
$n
「...In that case, I'll ask $$ボス$$ or $$木下$$ for special training...」

177:t_1:52.en:
$$スズネ$$
「T-that's enough...! You don't have to force yourself to change your character...!」

177:t_1:53.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What I wanted to say is something else.」

177:t_1:55.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Yes, yes. More to the point, let's go see everyone.」

177:t_1:57.en:
$$スズネ$$
(It's a good sign that he's started to see himself as part of the group. At this rate, getting over being sullen might not be far off.)

177:t_1:58.en:
$$スズネ$$
(But it's a little lonely that I won't be the only one he opens up to anymore...)

177:t_1:66.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Hangar ～

177:t_1:67.en:
$$甲児$$
「Glad you made it out safe, $$カミーユ$$.」

177:t_1:68.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Not that it's a situation we can be happy about.」

177:t_1:69.en:
$$甲児$$
「I heard that after we parted ways, the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$ joined up with $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ right away.」

177:t_1:70.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Yeah, that's right. $$刹那$$ and the other $$ガンダムマイスター$$s are all alive and well.」

177:t_1:71.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And from $$ソレスタルビーイング$$'s intel, we learned that $$フル・フロンタル$$ had become the new leader of $$ネオ・ジオン$$, so we went down to North America.」

177:t_1:73.en:
$$ファ$$
「North America is a fierce battleground where the forces of the $$地球連邦軍$$ and the Empire are evenly matched.」

177:t_1:74.en:
$$フォウ$$
「We fought the Empire there while investigating $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s movements.」

177:t_1:75.en:
$$甲児$$
「Why would $$ネオ・ジオン$$ come into it?」

177:t_1:76.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The Empire doesn't target space colonies. That gave rise to the suspicion that they and $$ネオ・ジオン$$ are in league.」

177:t_1:78.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「...It was true, unfortunately. We fought $$ギュネイ$$ in North America, and that's how we found out.」

177:t_1:79.en:
$$ボス$$
「That guy... He's still with $$ネオ・ジオン$$...!」

177:t_1:80.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$ hinted at cooperating with the $$ジェミニス$$ during the $$時獄戦役$$, too.」

177:t_1:81.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Rescuing $$チェーン$$, who was held captive by $$ジオン$$, and getting the $$νガンダム$$ back were the few gains of that battle.」

177:t_1:82.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Hold on, Captain $$アムロ$$! It'd be a problem if you forgot about us.」

177:t_1:83.en:
$$甲児$$
「So Lieutenant $$コーラサワー$$ has joined up, too.」

177:t_1:84.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「Yep. On the Colonel's... no, the Brigadier General's orders.」

177:t_1:85.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「In fact, $$ネオ・ジオン$$ wasn't the only one that joined hands with the Empire...」

177:t_1:86.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$クロノ$$ still has its roots in the $$地球連邦軍$$, and part of the military is already cooperating with the Empire.」

177:t_1:88.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But not all of the $$連邦軍$$ side with $$クロノ$$, starting with Brigadier General $$カティ$$.」
